notes.title: Update plan
notes.content:
Happy new year everyone 

It is a wonderfully time to release Suzunaan on Fire, our Creator Workgroup first game!

In upcoming few week, we will fix any bug that we find and more importantly update more stages. We know that some English translations are missing, it will be fixed in next few versions and more languages support are in plan. Also, in custom mode, we are planning to add more ground and prop objects which will link to steam workshop. 

In the end, Thanks everyone who support us. We will continue create more game and more fun :)

Good luck and have fun 
CreStruction-The Creator Workgroup
